title: Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt
function: Spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by spent fuel transport cask high-strength bolt and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for nuclear hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding all positions with Class 6g gauge
DPI dye penetrant inspect with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for spent fuel transport application
inspection: PMI XRF alloy verify (spent fuel verified)
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for spent fuel transport performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt is suitable for spent fuel transport in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt?
faq.a: Each Titanium Spent Fuel Cask Bolt shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for spent fuel transport.
